title: Amigo scene format v0.1
description: Shared scene format of spatialAmigo and motionAmigo. Units are meters and radians. The world frame is right-handed with z pointing up. Change only together with a version bump.

version.description: Format version. Must be exactly "0.1" for this schema.

frame.description: Name of the frame all poses are expressed in. v0.1 only knows the world frame.

objects.description: Objects in the scene, each one an oriented 3D box with a semantic label.

viewpoint.description: Optional observer pose. Needed for egocentric relations (left/right/front/behind as seen by the observer).

label.description: Semantic class, lower case, e.g. "mug" or "coffee table".

center.description: Center of the box in the world frame, meters.

size.description: Full edge lengths of the box along the object's own x, y and z axes, meters.

yaw.description: Rotation of the object frame about the world z axis, radians, counter-clockwise seen from above.

front.description: Optional unit vector in the object frame pointing out of the object's intrinsic front (e.g. the seat side of a chair). Objects without an intrinsic front omit it.

position.description: Observer (camera or eye) position in the world frame, meters.

look_at.description: Point the observer looks at, world frame, meters.
